question.zh: 标普500在 2027-02-23 或之后首个交易日收盘，会高于 2026-11-24 吗？
question.en: Will S&P 500 close higher on the first trading day on or after 2027-02-23 than on 2026-11-24?

rationale.zh: 基准：历史平均漂移 + HAR 波动率。信号模型回测技能分 -0.2%（p=0.908），未达到上线门槛。
rationale.en: Baseline: historical average drift + HAR volatility. The signal model scored -0.2% skill in backtests (p=0.908), below the publishing bar.
